passages.text: Nuestros horarios de atención son: Lunes a sábado. Turno mañana: de 9:30 a.m. a 1:30 p.m. Turno tarde: de 3:30 p.m. a 7:30 p.m. Te recomendamos escribirnos dentro de estos horarios para una respuesta más rápida.

note: F1 isolated image/continuity world 2026-09-12. Synthetic identities only. Every listed phone has zero pending/completed orders, zero carts, zero gift purchases, zero guest events and empty initial history. No mutable backend data. Seed history is typed data validated by the fixture gateway; invocation history is merged at runtime without image bytes.
